generators.carrier: object-level state reached by replaying an event sequence under a regime

relations.statement: Object-level states and their admitted judgments do not depend on token glyphs, component counts, order of admission, or string equality; token-level distinctions are visible only to the metatheory.
relations.hypotheses: Declared two-level metatheory/object-language split (ASSUME); no semantic interpretation assigned.

near_misses.claim: A state with two data requires admission of a second, different token.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Token distinctness is metatheory-only; object language has no tokens, so the claim is refused as vacuous (KNOWN- l_second_token_required).

near_misses.claim: g_replay composed at slot 0 with g_empty_regime licensed by r_split_declared.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: r_split_declared has no verified Lean statement; composition unlicensed (KNOWN- composition_unlicensed).

near_misses.claim: Token renaming invariance of replay output.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Presented as a proof without a sorry-free derivation; refused as vacuous (KNOWN- l_token_rename_invariance). Only checkable via renaming tests in Python/Rust.
